statement: For base Bernoulli(p) bond percolation on the standard Cayley graph of F(a,b), the open-path indicators for (e,a,a^2) and (e,a,ab) have marginals p^2 and joint probability p^3, and are incomparable in stochastic order with iid Bernoulli(p^2) indicators for every 0<p<1.
assumptions: Two length-two routes share exactly one edge
proof_or_counterexample: Intersection probability p^3 exceeds iid p^4; union probability 2p^2-p^3 is smaller than iid 2p^2-p^4. Thus the two increasing events rule out either domination. Exact rational checks at p=1/4,1/2,3/4 and disjoint-route controls: overlap_measurement.json.
remaining_gap: Independent proof check required; refutes only iid replacement/uncorrected comparison, not C0047.

statement: For countable connected locally finite simple undirected graphs G,H on the same vertex set, with each H-edge routed by a simple G-path of length at most L and every G-edge in at most M routes (integers L,M>=1), iid H-percolation with q=(1-(1-p)^(1/M))^L couples inside iid G-percolation at p. Consequently p_c^bond(G)<=1-(1-(p_c^bond(H))^(1/L))^M.
assumptions: Countable locally finite simple undirected graphs
proof_or_counterexample: Independent M-slot Bernoulli(t) variables at each base edge, distinct slots per route; OR gives iid base p and disjoint route variables plus independent thinning give iid q. Countable product space and component inclusion justify the critical-threshold limit. Written proof in bridge_derivation.md; 48 finite inclusion assignments checked in overlap_measurement.json.
independent_reviewer: w563 (requested; pending); w566 checks any referee-originated new claim
remaining_gap: No nonuniqueness transfer: extra base-open connections may merge distinct H-clusters. Lemma requires independent referee before theorem promotion.
